Class Attribute Value
<tag class = “name1 name2 name3 name4 ...”> 
In general, we call these names as class names
We can provide multiple names to the Class Attribute value

We take the help of attribute to combine HTML & CSS.

	We HAVE to write in the Start tag. 
		Attribute = syntax name of the Attribute. 
		Value is what you can set. 

Classnames are case sensitive

slides.title: Introduction to Bootstrap
slides.body:
How to use BootStrap?
To use the code snippets provided by Bootstrap,we need to add a piece of code within the head element. 
We call them BootstrapCDN
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
  	...
  </head>
  <body></body>
</html>
HTML
slides.notes:
Don’t make any changes
Already loaded in the code play ground below
Copy paste in main code playground
Note: Already BootstrapCDN is included in the code playground below the video.
 

You can Move to main playground if you want to use bootstrap in main playground

     crossorigin="anonymous"
   ></script>
   <script
     src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/popper.js@1.16.1/dist/umd/popper.min.js"
